# Plain Compass

> Plain Compass is a personal travel journal sharing firsthand travel experiences, destination reviews, hiking routes, accommodation insights, and practical transport tips.

## Website

[https://plaincompass.github.io/](https://plaincompass.github.io/)

## About

Articles cover destination reviews, routes, transportation, and accommodation.
All articles are based on firsthand travel experiences and personal
observations unless otherwise noted. Current coverage includes South Korea,
with additional destinations planned.

## Topics

- Travel Experiences
- Destination Reviews
- Hiking Trails
- Transportation Tips
- Accommodation Reviews
- Walking Trails

## Published Articles

### China

- [Can You Reach the Datong Volcano Area From Datong Airport Without a Taxi?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/datong/): My experience traveling from Datong Airport to the Datong Volcano area, including public transport challenges, taxi costs, a foreigner-friendly hotel, and practical tips for independent travelers.
- [Is Chaka Salt Lake Worth Visiting? My Experience Taking the Daytime Sleeper Train from Xining](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/chaka-salt-lake/): My experience visiting Chaka Salt Lake from Xining, including the five-hour daytime sleeper train, photography spots, crowds, altitude preparation, and why staying overnight is worth it.
- [Is the Datong Volcano Viewpoint Worth Visiting Without a Tour?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/datongvolcano/): A personal walking guide to the Datong Volcano area, including the volcano viewpoint near the volcano district, trail conditions, volcano views, and practical travel tips.

### Japan

- [Nukabira Lake Winter Walk: Quiet Snowy Landscape in Hokkaido](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/japan/nukabiralake/): A peaceful stroll around Nukabira Lake in February 2026, capturing clear skies, Mount Asahi in view, and a surprise wild deer encounter. The ice was melting and the snow thinner than expected, but the easy path and accessible bus ride from Obihiro made it a gentle, Nordic‑style winter forest experience.
- [Obihiro Travel Hub](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/japan/obihiro/): Obihiro serves as the base for visits to Nukabira Lake and Tokachikawa Onsen. Nukabira Lake is a frozen lake where visitors can walk on the ice and view Mount Asahi. Tokachikawa On
- [Tokachikawa Onsen (Obihiro): A Peaceful Hot Spring Escape in Hokkaido](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/japan/tokachionsenobihiro/): A one-night, two-day trip to Tokachikawa Onsen in Hokkaido, featuring a unique hot spring emerging from moss, peaceful open-air baths, and quiet small-town atmosphere. Includes tips on transportation, logistics, and what to bring.

### South Korea

- [Is Mt. Gwanak a Good Mountain to Hike During a Seoul Trip?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/south-korea/gwanak/): A personal hiking guide to Mt. Gwanak from Gwacheon Station, including the route to Yeonjuam Temple, trail tips, and a quiet prayer spot near the summit.
- [Is Mt. Mindungsan Worth Hiking in Jeongseon?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/south-korea/jeongseon-mindoong/): A personal hiking review of Mt. Mindungsan in Jeongseon, including the route from the second parking lot, the steep and slippery descent toward Jeungsan Elementary School, travel tips, reservation notes, and seasonal advice.
- [Is the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge a Difficult Hike?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/south-korea/geumsan-wellness-walk/): A personal review of the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge, including its uphill section, event experience, reservation notes, accessibility considerations, and a visit to the Seven Hundred Patriotic Martyrs Tomb.
